why: XLY +2.55 pct to $112.85, its first up week after eight down, clearing $111.10, the 20D and the $109.41 gap; the long fired Tuesday and the coil top $113.29 is 44 cents overhead -- but the breakout was bought on below-average volume (6.4M vs a 6.8M 20D) and AMZN+TSLA (41 pct of the fund) supplied ~1.6 of the 2.55 points (wiki/consumer-discretionary.md; macro/facts.json).

Nothing in the consumer file improved: UMich 46.3 with current conditions at an all-time low 44.7 on the worst durable-goods buying conditions in the survey, the 30-year mortgage 7.40 pct (second weekly rise), five names (HD, LOW, MCD, LULU, CMCSA) at 52-week closing lows inside the up week; nobody upgraded -- 'a paused Fed is a consequence of a slowing consumer, not a cure' (wiki/consumer-discretionary.md Ophelia; wiki/synthesis.md Section 4 item 3 and Wire 5).

Week RF raised 28 -> 30 and MC 42 -> 45: retail sales Thu (cons +0.3 pct, control +0.3; Chicago Fed real-terms estimate -0.7 pct) is the one print that can reconcile the tape with the survey, and CPI Wed decides whether the hike odds the week removed come back (wiki/economic-calendar.md; wiki/consumer-discretionary.md).
risks: Bullish falsifier: retail sales hold up and a cool CPI pulls the 10Y and the mortgage rate down together; a close over $113.29 -> 50D $114.23 -> 200D $115.67, which together turn a bounce into a trend change (wiki/consumer-discretionary.md Marky).

Falsifier: a close under the 20D $110.75 -> $109.41 -> $107.99; retail sales < -0.1 pct fires the Retail flag; control group < 0.0 = real demand rolling over (wiki/consumer-discretionary.md; wiki/economic-calendar.md REGIME RISK FLAGS).
The index is not the consumer: the fund's weights snapshot moved against the prices and the 50D is still under the 200D (bearish cross intact) (wiki/consumer-discretionary.md WILD CARD).

why: The month arithmetic is the worst on the board (rank 11, relative momentum 0, -5.62 pts vs SPY, breadth 30); YTD XLY -4.9 pct vs SPY +15.1 and XLP +9.5 (wiki/consumer-discretionary.md; inputs/2026-10-09/consumer_discretionary.json metrics).

The housing pair is a bounce into a worse number: HD 18.2x and LOW 14.3x off Monday's 52-week lows, 13-19 pct under their 200Ds with mortgages at 7.40 pct; BKNG 13.0x is Cecil's next buy and the print moved to Nov 3 (wiki/consumer-discretionary.md Cecil; wiki/synthesis.md Section 1).

Month RF raised 28 -> 30 and MC 45 -> 48: 41 pct of the fund reports inside the window -- GM Oct 20, TSLA Oct 21 (beat 3 of 8; last reaction -14.5 pct; straddle 7.5 pct below its realized norm; EPS basis unresolved $0.45 vs $0.22 GAAP), F Oct 28, AMZN Oct 29 (best of the seven this week), SBUX Oct 29, MAR Nov 2, BKNG Nov 3, MCD Nov 4 (wiki/earnings-surveillance.md; wiki/consumer-discretionary.md EARNINGS CALENDAR).
risks: COF/SYF card charge-offs Oct 20 and the Conference Board Oct 27 are the next hard consumer reads; CARG at RSI 30 is 'the consumer name on the list' (wiki/earnings-surveillance.md; wiki/communication-services.md).
Mortgage rates keep rising while the 10Y stays above 5 pct -> HD and LOW cut guides Nov 17-18 (outside the window but priced inside it) (wiki/consumer-discretionary.md RISK SCENARIOS).

Falsifier for the underweight: WTI under $90 gives travel and restaurants fuel relief (SBUX RSI 28.9, BKNG 36.6 the most oversold beneficiaries); TJX +4.6 and MAR +1.9 pct say the dispersion trade still works (wiki/consumer-discretionary.md).

extracts.lead_summary: The streak ended and the data did not get the memo. XLY rose 2.55% to $112.85, its first up week after eight straight down weeks, and cleared the $111.10 line and the whole $109.41 gap on the way. Meanwhile the University of Michigan's preliminary October sentiment read 46.3 against 47.6–48 expected, with its current-conditions gauge at an all-time low of 44.7 on the worst durable-goods buying conditions in the survey; Freddie Mac's 30-year mortgage rose again to 7.40%, up again. Five of the fifteen names here set 52-week closing lows during the week. The rally was Amazon (+4.3%), Tesla (+3.3%), and a bounce in names that were already broken. Nothing in the consumer file improved.
